data.title: Compare Objects: Putting three objects in order from longest to shortest
data.description: Compare and measure real-world objects by their attributes

challenges.instruction: Put these in order from longest to shortest.
challenges.correctAnswer: red ribbon, yellow pencil, blue string
challenges.hint: Put the longest object first, and the shortest object last.

challenges.instruction: Put these in order from shortest to longest.
challenges.correctAnswer: paper clip, green crayon, paint brush
challenges.hint: Start with the shortest object and end with the longest.

challenges.instruction: Put these in order from tallest to shortest.
challenges.correctAnswer: wooden door, kitchen chair, step stool
challenges.hint: Order the objects starting with the tallest down to the shortest.

challenges.instruction: Put these in order from shortest to tallest.
challenges.correctAnswer: rubber duck, soccer ball, desk lamp
challenges.hint: Start with the shortest object in height and go up to the tallest.

challenges.instruction: Put these in order from lightest to heaviest.
challenges.correctAnswer: metal paperclip, apple fruit, hardcover book
challenges.hint: Start with the lightest object and end with the heaviest.
